## 1. Create Figure Directories

```{r directories}
base <- here::here("figures")
subdirs <- c(
  "PCA",
  "Volcano",
  "DE_summary",
  "Heatmap"
)
invisible(lapply(file.path(base, subdirs), function(d) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}))
```

## 2. Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(PCAtools)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)
library(UpSetR)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## 3. Load Step 1 Data

```{r load-data}
results_dir <- here::here("results")
load(file.path(results_dir, "processed_data.RData"))

cat("mRNA filtered:", nrow(mrna_filtered), "genes x", ncol(mrna_filtered), "samples\n")
cat("lncRNA filtered:", nrow(lncrna_filtered), "genes x", ncol(lncrna_filtered), "samples\n")
cat("miRNA filtered:", nrow(mirna_filtered), "miRNAs x", ncol(mirna_filtered), "samples\n")
cat("\nTissue breakdown:\n")
print(table(tissue_vec))
```

## 4. Convert Rownames to Gene Symbols

```{r convert-symbols}
gene_info$gene_id_stripped <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_info$gene_id)

# --- mRNA: ENSEMBL -> gene symbol ---
mrna_ids_stripped <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(mrna_filtered))
mrna_symbols <- gene_info$gene_name[match(mrna_ids_stripped, gene_info$gene_id_stripped)]
keep <- !is.na(mrna_symbols)
mrna_filtered <- mrna_filtered[keep, ]
mrna_symbols  <- mrna_symbols[keep]
dups <- duplicated(mrna_symbols) | duplicated(mrna_symbols, fromLast = TRUE)
if (any(dups)) {
  row_means <- rowMeans(mrna_filtered)
  mrna_filtered <- mrna_filtered %>%
    mutate(.symbol = mrna_symbols, .mean = row_means) %>%
    group_by(.symbol) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = .mean, n = 1) %>%
    ungroup()
  mrna_symbols <- mrna_filtered$.symbol
  mrna_filtered <- mrna_filtered %>% select(-.symbol, -.mean)
}
rownames(mrna_filtered) <- mrna_symbols

# --- lncRNA: ENSEMBL -> gene symbol ---
lncrna_ids_stripped <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(lncrna_filtered))
lncrna_symbols <- gene_info$gene_name[match(lncrna_ids_stripped, gene_info$gene_id_stripped)]
keep <- !is.na(lncrna_symbols)
lncrna_filtered <- lncrna_filtered[keep, ]
lncrna_symbols  <- lncrna_symbols[keep]
dups <- duplicated(lncrna_symbols) | duplicated(lncrna_symbols, fromLast = TRUE)
if (any(dups)) {
  row_means <- rowMeans(lncrna_filtered)
  lncrna_filtered <- lncrna_filtered %>%
    mutate(.symbol = lncrna_symbols, .mean = row_means) %>%
    group_by(.symbol) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = .mean, n = 1) %>%
    ungroup()
  lncrna_symbols <- lncrna_filtered$.symbol
  lncrna_filtered <- lncrna_filtered %>% select(-.symbol, -.mean)
}
rownames(lncrna_filtered) <- lncrna_symbols

cat("mRNA after symbol conversion:", nrow(mrna_filtered), "genes\n")
cat("lncRNA after symbol conversion:", nrow(lncrna_filtered), "genes\n")
```

## 5. Verify and Prepare Data for DESeq2

```{r verify-prepare}
stopifnot(identical(names(tissue_vec), colnames(mrna_filtered)))
stopifnot(identical(names(tissue_vec), colnames(lncrna_filtered)))
stopifnot(identical(names(tissue_vec), colnames(mirna_filtered)))

condition <- factor(tissue_vec, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))

cat("Condition levels:", levels(condition), "\n")
cat("Normal:", sum(condition == "Normal"), "\n")
cat("Tumor:", sum(condition == "Tumor"), "\n")
```

## 6. DESeq2 — mRNA

```{r deseq2-mrna, cache=TRUE}
col_data <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(mrna_filtered))

dds_mrna <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = mrna_filtered,
  colData   = col_data,
  design    = ~ condition
)
dds_mrna <- DESeq(dds_mrna)
res_mrna <- results(dds_mrna, contrast = c("condition", "Tumor", "Normal"))

cat("mRNA DESeq2 complete.\n")
summary(res_mrna)
```

## DESeq2 — lncRNA

```{r deseq2-lncrna, cache=TRUE}
dds_lncrna <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = lncrna_filtered,
  colData   = col_data,
  design    = ~ condition
)
dds_lncrna <- DESeq(dds_lncrna)
res_lncrna <- results(dds_lncrna, contrast = c("condition", "Tumor", "Normal"))

cat("lncRNA DESeq2 complete.\n")
summary(res_lncrna)
```

## DESeq2 — miRNA

```{r deseq2-mirna, cache=TRUE}
dds_mirna <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = mirna_filtered,
  colData   = col_data,
  design    = ~ condition
)
dds_mirna <- DESeq(dds_mirna)
res_mirna <- results(dds_mirna, contrast = c("condition", "Tumor", "Normal"))

cat("miRNA DESeq2 complete.\n")
summary(res_mirna)
```

## 7. Apply DE Thresholds

|log2FC| > 1 and FDR < 0.05, as specified in the proposal.

```{r apply-thresholds}
de_mrna <- as.data.frame(res_mrna) %>%
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1, padj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(padj)

de_lncrna <- as.data.frame(res_lncrna) %>%
  rownames_to_column("symbol") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1, padj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(padj)

de_mirna <- as.data.frame(res_mirna) %>%
  rownames_to_column("miRNA_ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1, padj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(padj)

cat("DE mRNAs (|log2FC| > 1, FDR < 0.05):", nrow(de_mrna), "\n")
cat("  Upregulated:", sum(de_mrna$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
cat("  Downregulated:", sum(de_mrna$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")

cat("\nDE lncRNAs (|log2FC| > 1, FDR < 0.05):", nrow(de_lncrna), "\n")
cat("  Upregulated:", sum(de_lncrna$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
cat("  Downregulated:", sum(de_lncrna$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")

cat("\nDE miRNAs (|log2FC| > 1, FDR < 0.05):", nrow(de_mirna), "\n")
cat("  Upregulated:", sum(de_mirna$log2FoldChange > 0), "\n")
cat("  Downregulated:", sum(de_mirna$log2FoldChange < 0), "\n")
```

## 8. PCA Plots

```{r pca-vst}
vsd <- vst(dds_mrna, blind = TRUE)

meta <- data.frame(
  condition = condition,
  row.names = colnames(vsd)
)

p <- pca(assay(vsd), metadata = meta, removeVar = 0.1)
```

### PCA Biplot

```{r pca-biplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
biplot_pca <- biplot(p,
  colby          = "condition",
  encircle       = TRUE,
  encircleFill   = TRUE,
  showLoadings   = FALSE,
  lab            = NULL,
  legendPosition = "right",
  title          = "PCA Biplot: UCEC Tumor vs Normal",
  pointSize      = 1
)
biplot_pca

ggsave(file.path(base, "PCA", "PCA_biplot.pdf"), plot = biplot_pca, width = 8, height = 6)
```

## 10. Volcano Plots — Combined Panel

```{r volcano-panel, fig.width=24, fig.height=10}
# --- mRNA volcano ---
df_mrna <- as.data.frame(res_mrna) %>% filter(!is.na(padj))
df_mrna$label <- ifelse(rownames(df_mrna) %in% de_mrna$symbol,
                        rownames(df_mrna), "")

v_mrna <- EnhancedVolcano(df_mrna,
  lab             = df_mrna$label,
  title           = "mRNA",
  subtitle        = "",
  caption         = "",
  x               = "log2FoldChange",
  y               = "padj",
  ylab            = bquote(~ -Log[10] ~ italic(FDR)),
  legendLabels    = c("NS", expression(Log[2] ~ FC), "FDR",
                      expression(FDR ~ and ~ log[2] ~ FC)),
  FCcutoff        = 1,
  pCutoff         = 0.05,
  axisLabSize     = 12,
  max.overlaps    = 15,
  drawConnectors  = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.5,
  arrowheads      = FALSE,
  boxedLabels     = TRUE,
  labSize         = 2.5
)

# --- lncRNA volcano ---
df_lncrna <- as.data.frame(res_lncrna) %>% filter(!is.na(padj))
df_lncrna$label <- ifelse(rownames(df_lncrna) %in% de_lncrna$symbol,
                          rownames(df_lncrna), "")

v_lncrna <- EnhancedVolcano(df_lncrna,
  lab             = df_lncrna$label,
  title           = "lncRNA",
  subtitle        = "",
  caption         = "",
  x               = "log2FoldChange",
  y               = "padj",
  ylab            = bquote(~ -Log[10] ~ italic(FDR)),
  legendLabels    = c("NS", expression(Log[2] ~ FC), "FDR",
                      expression(FDR ~ and ~ log[2] ~ FC)),
  FCcutoff        = 1,
  pCutoff         = 0.05,
  axisLabSize     = 12,
  max.overlaps    = 15,
  drawConnectors  = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.5,
  arrowheads      = FALSE,
  boxedLabels     = TRUE,
  labSize         = 2.5
)

# --- miRNA volcano ---
df_mirna <- as.data.frame(res_mirna) %>% filter(!is.na(padj))
df_mirna$label <- rownames(df_mirna)

v_mirna <- EnhancedVolcano(df_mirna,
  lab             = df_mirna$label,
  title           = "miRNA",
  subtitle        = "",
  caption         = "",
  x               = "log2FoldChange",
  y               = "padj",
  ylab            = bquote(~ -Log[10] ~ italic(FDR)),
  legendLabels    = c("NS", expression(Log[2] ~ FC), "FDR",
                      expression(FDR ~ and ~ log[2] ~ FC)),
  FCcutoff        = 1,
  pCutoff         = 0.05,
  axisLabSize     = 12,
  max.overlaps    = 15,
  drawConnectors  = TRUE,
  widthConnectors = 0.5,
  arrowheads      = FALSE,
  boxedLabels     = TRUE,
  labSize         = 2.5
)

# --- Combine into panel with patchwork ---
volcano_panel <- v_mrna + v_lncrna + v_mirna +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

volcano_panel
ggsave(file.path(base, "Volcano", "Volcano_panel.pdf"),
       plot = volcano_panel, width = 24, height = 10)
ggsave(file.path(base, "Volcano", "Volcano_panel.png"),
       plot = volcano_panel, width = 24, height = 10, dpi = 150)
```

## 11. Up/Down Regulation Summary

```{r up-down}
up <- list(
  mRNA   = de_mrna %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% pull(symbol),
  lncRNA = de_lncrna %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% pull(symbol),
  miRNA  = de_mirna %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% pull(miRNA_ID)
)
down <- list(
  mRNA   = de_mrna %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% pull(symbol),
  lncRNA = de_lncrna %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% pull(symbol),
  miRNA  = de_mirna %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% pull(miRNA_ID)
)

cat("Up-regulated: mRNA =", length(up$mRNA), ", lncRNA =", length(up$lncRNA), ", miRNA =", length(up$miRNA), "\n")
cat("Down-regulated: mRNA =", length(down$mRNA), ", lncRNA =", length(down$lncRNA), ", miRNA =", length(down$miRNA), "\n")
```

## 12. DE Summary Barplot

```{r de-barplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
de_summary <- data.frame(
  RNA_Type  = rep(c("mRNA", "lncRNA", "miRNA"), each = 2),
  Direction = rep(c("Up", "Down"), 3),
  Count     = c(
    length(up$mRNA), length(down$mRNA),
    length(up$lncRNA), length(down$lncRNA),
    length(up$miRNA), length(down$miRNA)
  )
)

de_bar <- ggplot(de_summary, aes(x = RNA_Type, y = Count, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#E41A1C", "Down" = "#377EB8")) +
  labs(
    title = "Differentially Expressed Genes: Tumor vs Normal",
    subtitle = "|log2FC| > 1, FDR < 0.05",
    x = NULL, y = "Number of DE Genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
de_bar

ggsave(file.path(base, "DE_summary", "DE_barplot.pdf"), plot = de_bar, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(base, "DE_summary", "DE_barplot.png"), plot = de_bar, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## 13. Heatmap of Top DE mRNAs

```{r heatmap-top-de, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
top_mrna_symbols <- head(de_mrna$symbol, 30)

matched_symbols <- top_mrna_symbols[top_mrna_symbols %in% rownames(vsd)]
cat("Matched genes for heatmap:", length(matched_symbols), "out of", length(top_mrna_symbols), "\n")

mat <- assay(vsd)[matched_symbols, , drop = FALSE]

# Remove any zero-variance rows
row_vars <- apply(mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
mat <- mat[row_vars > 0, , drop = FALSE]
cat("Genes after variance filter:", nrow(mat), "\n")

ann_col <- data.frame(Tissue = condition, row.names = colnames(mat))
ann_colors <- list(Tissue = c("Normal" = "#377EB8", "Tumor" = "#E41A1C"))

pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale             = "row",
  color             = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
  annotation_col    = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  fontsize_row      = 7,
  main              = "Top 30 DE mRNAs: Tumor vs Normal",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2"
)

dev.copy2pdf(file = file.path(base, "Heatmap", "Top30_DE_mRNA_heatmap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)
```

## Heatmap of Top DE lncRNAs

```{r heatmap-lncrna, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
vsd_lncrna <- vst(dds_lncrna, blind = FALSE)

top_lncrna_symbols <- head(de_lncrna$symbol, 30)
matched_lncrna <- top_lncrna_symbols[top_lncrna_symbols %in% rownames(vsd_lncrna)]

mat_lnc <- assay(vsd_lncrna)[matched_lncrna, , drop = FALSE]

row_vars_lnc <- apply(mat_lnc, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
mat_lnc <- mat_lnc[row_vars_lnc > 0, , drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(

  annotation_col    = ann_col,

  fontsize_row      = 8,
  main              = "Top 30 DE lncRNAs: Tumor vs Normal",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2"
)

dev.copy2pdf(file = file.path(base, "Heatmap", "Top30_DE_lncRNA_heatmap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)
```

## Heatmap of Top DE miRNAs

```{r heatmap-mirna, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
vsd_mirna <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_mirna, blind = FALSE)

top_mirna_ids <- head(de_mirna$miRNA_ID, 30)
matched_mirna <- top_mirna_ids[top_mirna_ids %in% rownames(vsd_mirna)]

mat_mir <- assay(vsd_mirna)[matched_mirna, , drop = FALSE]

row_vars_mir <- apply(mat_mir, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
mat_mir <- mat_mir[row_vars_mir > 0, , drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(
  mat_mir,
  scale             = "row",
  color             = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50),
  annotation_col    = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  fontsize_row      = 8,
  main              = "Top 30 DE miRNAs: Tumor vs Normal",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2"
)
```

## 14. Extract Normalized Expression for Downstream Correlation

```{r normalized-expression}
vsd_mirna <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_mirna, blind = FALSE)

tumor_keys  <- names(tissue_vec[tissue_vec == "Tumor"])
normal_keys <- names(tissue_vec[tissue_vec == "Normal"])
cat("Tumor samples:", length(tumor_keys), "\n")
cat("Normal samples:", length(normal_keys), "\n")

# --- Tumor ---
de_mrna_expr_tumor   <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd)[de_mrna$symbol[de_mrna$symbol %in% rownames(vsd)], tumor_keys])
de_lncrna_expr_tumor <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd_lncrna)[de_lncrna$symbol[de_lncrna$symbol %in% rownames(vsd_lncrna)], tumor_keys])
de_mirna_expr_tumor  <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd_mirna)[de_mirna$miRNA_ID[de_mirna$miRNA_ID %in% rownames(vsd_mirna)], tumor_keys])

# --- Normal ---
de_mrna_expr_normal   <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd)[de_mrna$symbol[de_mrna$symbol %in% rownames(vsd)], normal_keys])
de_lncrna_expr_normal <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd_lncrna)[de_lncrna$symbol[de_lncrna$symbol %in% rownames(vsd_lncrna)], normal_keys])
de_mirna_expr_normal  <- as.data.frame(assay(vsd_mirna)[de_mirna$miRNA_ID[de_mirna$miRNA_ID %in% rownames(vsd_mirna)], normal_keys])

cat("\n--- Tumor ---\n")
cat("mRNA:", nrow(de_mrna_expr_tumor), "x", ncol(de_mrna_expr_tumor), "\n")
cat("lncRNA:", nrow(de_lncrna_expr_tumor), "x", ncol(de_lncrna_expr_tumor), "\n")
cat("miRNA:", nrow(de_mirna_expr_tumor), "x", ncol(de_mirna_expr_tumor), "\n")

cat("\n--- Normal ---\n")
cat("mRNA:", nrow(de_mrna_expr_normal), "x", ncol(de_mrna_expr_normal), "\n")
cat("lncRNA:", nrow(de_lncrna_expr_normal), "x", ncol(de_lncrna_expr_normal), "\n")
cat("miRNA:", nrow(de_mirna_expr_normal), "x", ncol(de_mirna_expr_normal), "\n")
```

```{r}
save(
  dds_mrna, dds_lncrna, dds_mirna,
  res_mrna, res_lncrna, res_mirna,
  de_mrna, de_lncrna, de_mirna,
  de_mrna_expr_tumor, de_lncrna_expr_tumor, de_mirna_expr_tumor,
  de_mrna_expr_normal, de_lncrna_expr_normal, de_mirna_expr_normal,
  vsd, vsd_lncrna, vsd_mirna,
  tumor_keys, normal_keys,
  condition,
  file = file.path(results_dir, "de_results.RData")
)
```
